HOW TO IMPORT INTO ASEPRITE & SAVE AS .ASEPRITE
════════════════════════════════════════════════

Step 1 — Open a PNG
  File → Open → select any PNG from the /PNG folder
  (e.g. 01_shrine_wall_segment_32x32.png)

Step 2 — Verify canvas size
  Make sure the canvas is 32x32 px.
  Go to Edit → Canvas Size if needed.

Step 3 — Load the color palette
  Window → Palettes → click "..." → Load Palette
  Select: feudal_japan_structures_palette.gpl

Step 4 — Add layers (optional)
  Layer panel → click "+" to add a new layer.
  Useful for animation frames or color variants.

Step 5 — Save as Aseprite source file
  File → Save As → choose "Aseprite (*.aseprite)"
  Suggested name: feudal_japan_structures.aseprite

Step 6 — Re-export to PNG (optional)
  File → Export Sprite Sheet
  → Type: Packed / By Rows
  → Output: PNG

── TILEABLE ASSETS NOTE ─────────────────────────────────

  Two assets in this pack are designed to tile:

  01_shrine_wall_segment — tiles horizontally (X axis)
    Place copies side by side to build a long wall.

  04_wooden_bridge — tiles vertically (Y axis)
    Stack copies top-to-bottom to extend bridge length.

  In Tiled / LDtk: simply stamp the tile repeatedly.
  In RPG Maker: use as an event graphic or tileset tile.
